name: HAWK
recent: Steel Hawk 近期在 Perak 获得三份住宅 EPCC 合约，总值 RM57.68 million，使近期住宅合约总额达 RM116.92 million。公司于 2026 年 9 月 30 日完成对 Sparksfly O&G Sdn Bhd 的股份认购。最新季度（2026-06-30）营收同比增 50.3%，但净亏损 RM9.41 million。
notable: 获得三份位于 Perak 的住宅 EPCC 合约，总值 RM57.68 million。
完成对 Sparksfly O&G Sdn Bhd 的股份认购。
集团首席执行官 Haffiz bin Hussin 在 9 月多次增持公司股份。
risks: 最新季度净亏损 RM9.41 million，亏损同比扩大。
净利率由上一季度的 9.8% 转为 -53.1%。
earnings: 2026-06-30 季度营收 RM17.72 million，同比增 50.3%，环比降 14.5%；净亏损 RM9.41 million，净利率 -53.1%，上一季度净利率为 9.8%。

recent_en: Steel Hawk recently secured three residential EPCC contracts in Perak worth RM57.68 million, bringing recent housing awards to RM116.92 million. The company completed its subscription of shares in Sparksfly O&G Sdn Bhd on 30 September 2026. In the latest quarter (2026-06-30), revenue rose 50.3% year-on-year but the company recorded a net loss of RM9.41 million.
notable_en: Secured three residential EPCC contracts in Perak worth RM57.68 million.
Completed the subscription of shares in Sparksfly O&G Sdn Bhd.
Group Chief Executive Officer Haffiz bin Hussin acquired shares in the company multiple times in September.
risks_en: Latest quarter recorded a net loss of RM9.41 million, with losses widening year-on-year.
Net margin turned to -53.1% from 9.8% in the previous quarter.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 2026-06-30, revenue was RM17.72 million, up 50.3% year-on-year and down 14.5% quarter-on-quarter; net loss was RM9.41 million with a net margin of -53.1%, compared with a net margin of 9.8% in the previous quarter.
